title: Jeff Bezos's Spaceport: Ranch deal built Blue Origin base; space tourism costs stay high
content: Jeff Bezos acquired 165,000 acres of land in West Texas to develop Blue Origin's spaceflight operations. The company launched its first crewed flight on July 20, 2021, with four passengers aboard. This historic mission marked significant milestones in commercial space travel and the efforts to expand human access to space. Blue Origin aims to make space travel available for more people beyond government programs.

title: 'India have totally spoiled Sooryavanshi's confidence': Ex-cricketer makes bold claim
content: Former India captain Krishnamachari Srikkanth criticised the team management for frequently changing the opening combination, saying it has hurt Sanju Samson and Vaibhav Sooryavanshi’s confidence. He questioned Samson’s inconsistency and suggested giving both players more opportunities. Meanwhile, West Indies defeated India by 24 runs in the fourth T20I, with Shai Hope scoring an unbeaten century to level the series 2-2.

title: Tyler Perry turned 330-acre former Army base into major Atlanta film studio
content: In 2015, Tyler Perry acquired the former Fort McPherson Army base in Atlanta for $30 million, and transformed it into a major production hub featuring 12 sound stages. This initiative not only aims to create new jobs but also emphasizes the importance of preserving historical structures while meeting the evolving demands of the film industry. Perry’s vision includes nurturing local talent to foster growth in South Atlanta's creative landscape.

title: 5 wickets in an over! SA bowler makes history with rare feat - Watch
content: Laycock finished with career-best figures of 6/26, including a record of four wickets in four consecutive deliveries in South African T20 cricket.

title: Mike Tyson sued for £1.5M over Rabona deal, denies breach
content: Mike Tyson and his wife, Lakiha, are facing a £1.5 million High Court legal battle over a Rabona sponsorship deal. The gambling company alleges Tyson breached his contract after withdrawing from a campaign involving a giant talking pigeon. Tyson and his promotional business, Tyrannic, deny breaching the agreement. The hearing is continuing in London.

title: Edible Schoolyard turns 31, now spans 5,800 programs in 75 countries
content: Launched back in 1995 in California, the Edible Schoolyard Project has blossomed into a global initiative founded by chef Alice Waters. The project imparts essential lessons on gardening and environmental stewardship, seamlessly integrating with subjects like science and math. With a mission to foster healthy eating habits, it has inspired educational platforms across more than 75 countries, aiming to weave food education into everyday school curricula for enhanced student wellbeing.

title: US ends 540-day grace period for immigrants after work authorisation expires
content: In a significant policy shift, the US Department of Homeland Security has abolished the 540-day automatic extension for work permits. This development results in immediate loss of work authorization for many, particularly affecting H-4 visa holders and asylum seekers, even while their renewal applications are pending. Moreover, the USCIS continues to face notable delays in processing these renewals, leading to a legal challenge from impacted parties contesting the new regulation.

title: Nagaland hunters turn protectors to save Amur falcons at Doyang
content: Nestled in Nagaland, Doyang Reservoir stands as a critical sanctuary for the migratory Amur falcons during autumn. Formerly a hub for hunters, the village of Pangti has embraced conservation. A ban on falcon hunting—prompted by 2012's outcry—has empowered local organizations to safeguard these birds and promote responsible tourism. This transformation highlights a dedicated community effort towards environmental preservation and birdwatching.

title: Patrick and Brittany Mahomes’ Volunteer for 15 program promotes youth community service.
content: Brittany and Patrick Mahomes foundation, 15 and the Mahomies collaborated with Youth Volunteer Corps for Volunteer for 15 program. Several young people have contributed countless hours and raised millions over the past four years. The kids learn about people from different background, racial equity, and environmental disasters. They spend more time in community service.

title: Travis Kelce's 87 Running Foundation helps rebuild former athlete's 56-year-old home
content: Gloria White’s home was rebuilt by Travis Kelce’s foundation. She had stayed there for 56 years. She was 79 years old when she sought help for her Kansas City home.

title: Hope's ton, Paul's five-for sink India; West Indies level series in Hyderabad
content: Paul led the West Indies bowling effort, taking five wickets for 41 runs in his four overs to help seal the win.

title: Abhishek Sharma breaks SKY's record for most sixes in a calendar year
content: The Indian opener hit his 69th six of 2026, going past former India captain Suryakumar Yadav's record of 68, which he set in 2022.

title: Blue drum murder case: Judge invokes 'Mahabharata' while giving death penalty
content: A Meerut court has sentenced Muskan Rastogi and her lover Sahil Shukla to death for murder. They were found guilty of murdering Muskan's husband, Saurabh Rajput, and hiding evidence. The trial included the testimony of 22 witnesses and numerous hearings over 18 months. Rajput’s mother expressed her gratitude for the verdict, hoping it deters future crimes. Both convicts were sentenced after their trial concluded on Wednesday.

title: Shai Hope scripts history, surpasses Chris Gayle in major T20I milestone for West Indies
content: In an explosive performance, Shai Hope delivered an unbeaten 102 from just 50 balls during the fourth T20I against India, becoming the first player from the West Indies to notch three T20I centuries. His outstanding innings propelled West Indies to an impressive 247/3 after 20 overs, with vital contributions from Shimron Hetmyer and Sherfane Rutherford, leaving Indian bowlers struggling to keep up with the relentless West Indies pace.

title: Child among 6 killed in small plane crash in Wisconsin; FAA, NTSB probe underway
content: Six individuals lost their lives, including a child, after a plane crash in Wisconsin Dells. The small Piper PA-46 was travelling from Kenosha to Menomonie when it went down. Weather conditions at the time are being investigated to determine their impact on the crash. Authorities received reports of the aircraft down just before 10 pm, with rescue teams finding no survivors.

title: 'Why are you ruining nation?' Dipke heckled, called 'CIA agent' at Delhi airport

title: India working on China ties, says Piyush Goyal
content:
India is working to develop relations with China once again, provided continuity in the engagement is warranted, geopolitical situation does not deteriorate and a fair deal is ensured, said commerce and industry minister Piyush Goyal Wednesday, adding that the "last word" on this journey is not yet scripted. "...I think we had some concerns in the past. We are working to develop the relations with China once again," said Goyal in response to a query whether China can be a part of joint ventures in critical sectors at the Bloomberg New Economy Forum. China is the second-largest trading partner for India, with bilateral trade rising nearly 8% in 2025-26 to $128 billion. Goyal also said ties between India and US remain "substantive" and "very consequential" for the world, which are poised to get better, irrespective of any changes in political thinking in both the countries. "...The relationship draws its strength from economic, political, and security imperatives.

title: India to Starlink: Comply with rules before entering market
content: govt has no objection to the satellite internet provider rolling out its services in India . a base station is a radio transmitter and receiver that acts as a local hub . the requirement to set up "base stations" will help authorities to secure compliance with laws .

title: Jantar Mantar breach: Das, Ranka sent to 5-day custody
content: 14 party members allegedly trespassed into Jantar Mantar, no longer a designated protest venue, and obstructed cops on duty . police said the action was prompted by repeated alleged violations of law and concerns that accused could again disturb public peace .

title: After Musk’s Ambani meltdown, Rubio to visit Reliance refinery
content: the brief stopover in jamnagar is being seen through the lens of Reliance’s plans to invest in a major refinery in Texas, the first of its kind in 50 years in the US . the announcement comes days after billionaire Elon Musk’s social media jab – addressing Mukesh Ambani as PM ambani and the real boss of India – over alleged regulatory delays .

title: Why Munir's plan to 'split' up Pakistan may spell the end of its civilian govt
content: field marshal Asim Munir is considering a radical solution to governance problems . he is considering breaking up the country's four provinces into 12 to 15 smaller provinces . smaller units, according to the argument for restructuring, would be easier to govern . but in a country where the military has long wielded influence over civilian governments, the political question is whether they would also be easy to control .

title: Mumbai ATC software glitch behind Air India false hijack scare? Probe on
